question: By how many billion dollars is the Li-ion battery recycling market projected to grow between 2025 and 2030, and at what annual growth rate?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%billion%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%cagr%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%2030%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%growth%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%market%'

WITH t AS (SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p2.L58') SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, '\$([0-9.]+) billion in 2025', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS start_bn, CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'to \$([0-9.]+) billion by 2030', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS end_bn, CAST(regexp_extract(text, 'to \$([0-9.]+) billion by 2030', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract(text, '\$([0-9.]+) billion in 2025', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS increase_bn FROM t
